notes: Site is Adobe Commerce (Magento) fronted by an Edge-Delivery-Services SPA (client-rendered /us/c/<path> pages) with a public GraphQL endpoint (https://www.visualcomfort.com/graphql). No login/trade gate on catalog data. Discovered the full Bestsellers taxonomy from /query-index.json (708-row EDS content index): a genuine mirrored sub-tree at /us/c/best-sellers with per-product-type children (ceiling, fans, floor, outdoor, table, wall) and, one level deeper, per-fixture-type grandchildren (e.g. best-sellers/ceiling/chandelier, best-sellers/floor/decorative, best-sellers/wall/bath) mirroring the site's main Lighting category tree. Verified every candidate's exact qty via the public GraphQL query products(filter:{category_url_path:{eq:"<path>"}}){total_count}, and cross-checked existence/product_count independently via categories(filters:{url_path:{eq:"<path>"}}){items{id name url_path product_count}} - both methods agreed exactly (e.g. best-sellers/ceiling = 113 via both). All 17 third-level nodes (best-sellers/ceiling/chandelier, /flush-mount, /hanging-shade, /lantern, /linear, /pendant; best-sellers/floor/decorative, /task; best-sellers/outdoor/ceiling, /wall; best-sellers/table/decorative, /task; best-sellers/wall/bath, /decorative, /picture, /task) resolved as real, live, existing categories (non-empty categories() lookup, real category ids) but with product_count=0 - genuinely empty listings, dropped per the zero-product rule rather than treated as broken/missing. This leaves a clean two-level structure: Bestsellers (top, 294) with six live per-product-type children. Also checked main nav, footer, and sitemap-en-us.xml for any additional Bestsellers-style wording (Top Sellers, Popular, Customer Favorites, Trending) - none found outside this /best-sellers tree. No overlap-exclusion issues: these are the same fixtures that also live in the main Lighting category tree (expected, not an error).
